# Leslie Moore

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c10 P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c33 P0](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher at the Glen school  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Appearance

Leslie is an extraordinarily beautiful young woman with sea-blue eyes, a white throat, and gleaming hair that resembles molten gold and reaches to her feet. She possesses a striking, golden-like beauty that draws immediate admiration, though she carries herself with a cold and quiet demeanor.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028), [v4 c12 P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 c12 P15](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0015), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)_

## Personality

Leslie has a complex, proud, and passionate nature that has been shaped by immense personal tragedy. Though naturally intelligent, friendly, and spirited, her severe hardships made her guarded, intense, and prone to bitterness. She possesses a deep capacity for affection and loyalty toward those close to her, but her severe pride makes her reluctant to accept gifts or pity from others.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029), [v4 c10 P31](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0031), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000), [v4 c31 P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001)_

## Traits

- Proud and independent  <sub>[v4 c31 P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001)</sub>
- Intelligent and ambitious  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Resilient and resolute  <sub>[v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)</sub>
- Fond of stormy weather and wild seas  <sub>[v4 c10 P21](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0021)</sub>

## Abilities

- Accomplished student, completing two years of work in one year at Queen's Academy to obtain her First Class license  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- Originally aimed to earn enough teaching to put herself through Redmond College  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>

## History

Leslie spent years caring for a brain-damaged man brought home by Captain Jim, whom everyone believed to be her husband Dick Moore. After becoming close neighbors with Anne Shirley at Four Winds, Leslie developed a deep friendship with her and found solace visiting the little house of dreams. Upon learning from Gilbert Blythe and Captain Jim that a medical operation might restore the man's lost faculties, Leslie mortgaged her farm to Captain Jim to fund a trip to a Montreal hospital. The operation proved successful and restored his memory, revealing that he was actually Dick's double cousin, George Moore, and that the real Dick Moore had died of yellow fever years prior in Cuba. Free from her tragic burden, Leslie returned home to adjust to her new life and stayed with Anne at the little house of dreams while courted by Owen Ford.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P24](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0024), [v4 c31 P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 c31 P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 c32 P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 c33 P0](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0000), [v4 c33 P5](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0005), [v4 c36 P25](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0025), [v4 c36 P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027)_

## Background by volume

- Her younger brother Kenneth was tragically killed in a farm accident when she was twelve  <sub>[v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Her father hanged himself in their home when she was fourteen, and she discovered his body  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy using money left by her grandmother West  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Married Dick Moore, who subsequently left on a sea voyage  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Quotes

> If we are to be friends you must call me Leslie.  <sub>[v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029)</sub>

> I suppose I am beautiful. I hate my beauty. I wish I had always been as brown and plain as the brownest and plainest girl at the fishing village over there.  <sub>[v4 c10 P31](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0031)</sub>

> You are setting a feast of fat things before me.  <sub>[v4 c12 P11](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0011)</sub>

> Oh, you dear, beautiful, beloved baby.  <sub>[v4 c36 P29](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0029)</sub>
